--- pyproject ---
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "alphalab"
version = "0.3.0"
description = "AlphaLab barebone quant framework with pluggable data providers and a workstation shell"
readme = "README.md"
license = {text = "MIT"}
authors = [{name = "LYT"}]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
keywords = ["quantitative", "backtesting", "alpha", "factor", "portfolio"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Financial and Insurance Industry",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Office/Business :: Financial :: Investment",
]
dependencies = [
    "pandas>=2.0.0",
    "numpy>=1.24.0",
    "scipy>=1.10.0",
    "pydantic>=2.0.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "loguru>=0.7.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.0.0",
    "pytest-cov>=4.0.0",
    "black",
    "ruff",
]
dashboard = [
    "fastapi>=0.100.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.23.0",
    "httpx>=0.24.0",
]
all = [
    "fastapi>=0.100.0",
    "uvicorn>=0.23.0",
    "httpx>=0.24.0",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/LYT/quant-framework"
Repository = "https://github.com/LYT/quant-framework"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["."]
include = ["alphalab*", "dashboard*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"alphalab.strategies" = ["*.yaml"]
"alphalab" = ["schema.sql"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
python_files = ["test_*.py"]

[tool.black]
line-length = 100
target-version = ["py310", "py311", "py312"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py310"
extend-exclude = [
    "artifacts",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "data",
    "logs",
    "outputs",
    "results",
    "scratch",
    "dashboard/frontend/node_modules",
    "dashboard/frontend/dist",
    "dashboard/frontend/dist-electron",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I"]
ignore = ["E501"]
